Venue and symbol are positional; `bar` is '1m', '1h' (default) or '1d' (named `bar` because `interval` is reserved). `ts` is the bar start (UTC); open/high/low/close per underlying unit (NULL when nothing traded); `volume_contracts`, `volume_usd`, and `open_interest_contracts` on Kalshi. Bitnomial serves daily bars only.

## candles(venue, symbol, start_date := NULL, end_date := NULL, bar := '1h')

Normalized OHLCV bars.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Two weeks of daily Kalshi BTC closes, volume and open interest", "sql": "SELECT ts, close, volume_usd, open_interest_contracts FROM perps.main.candles('kalshi', 'KXBTCPERP', bar := '1d') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 14"}, {"description": "Coinbase ETH perp trading range over the last day", "sql": "SELECT max(high) - min(low) AS range_usd FROM perps.main.candles('coinbase', 'ETP-20DEC30-CDE', start_date := now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY)"}, {"description": "Kalshi BTC perp, last week: each daily bar's open-to-close return next to the funding its three settlements charged longs, both in bps", "sql": "WITH bars AS (SELECT ts, coalesce(lead(ts) OVER (ORDER BY ts), ts + INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS bar_end, (close / open - 1) * 1e4 AS return_bps FROM perps.main.candles('kalshi', 'KXBTCPERP', bar := '1d')) SELECT b.ts, b.return_bps, sum(f.rate_bps) AS funding_bps FROM bars AS b JOIN perps.main.funding(venue := 'kalshi', underlying := 'BTC') AS f ON f.funding_time > b.ts AND f.funding_time <= b.bar_end GROUP BY b.ts, b.return_bps HAVING count(*) = 3 ORDER BY b.ts"}]

Perp premium in bps: each contract's mark against its own venue index, or against another venue's price

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Premium of each contract's mark over a reference, in bps (positive = perp trades rich). Default reference is the contract's own venue index; `reference := 'hyperliquid'` (any venue name) compares against that venue's index for the same underlying (or its mark if it publishes no index), which exposes cross-venue basis. Columns: `mark_price`, `mark_source`, `reference_price`, `reference_source`, `premium_bps`, `premium_usd`. Arguments `venue` and `underlying` filter as in marks(). Kalshi's index-perp reference levels are venue-specific and not comparable to other venues' index perps.

## premium(venue := NULL, underlying := NULL, reference := NULL)

Mark vs the venue index, or vs another venue's price for the same underlying.

ESTIMATE of liquidation price bands from open interest, an assumed leverage mix and the venue's maintenance margin

rows.vgi.doc_llm: An ESTIMATE, not venue data: splits a contract's open interest (both sides hold all of it) across an assumed leverage distribution and computes each bucket's liquidation price for an isolated linear position entered at the mark: X = entry * (side - 1/L) / (side - mm). `liquidation_estimate('hyperliquid', 'BTC')`; venue and symbol are positional. Parameters: `leverages` (default '2,3,5,10,20'), `weights` (default '0.30,0.25,0.20,0.15,0.10'), `mm_rate` (maintenance fraction), `entry_price`. With `mm_rate` NULL it uses the venue's documented maintenance margin and REFUSES venues that publish none (Kalshi, Coinbase, Bitnomial, Binance, Bybit): pass `mm_rate` to estimate them under your own assumption. Every row carries `estimate_method`, `mm_source` and `feasible`; `cum_notional_usd` accumulates per side nearest-first.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
## liquidation_estimate(venue, symbol, leverages, weights, mm_rate := NULL, entry_price := NULL)

**Estimate.** Liquidation bands from open interest and an assumed leverage mix; refuses venues without a published maintenance schedule unless `mm_rate` is given.

Kalshi funding for one window, computed from the per-second premium with Kalshi's linear time weights: accrued so far, projected to settlement, or reconstructed for a past window

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Forecast or reconstruct a Kalshi perp funding settlement: `kalshi_funding_nowcast('KXBTCPERP')` for the current window, `funding_time := TIMESTAMPTZ '...'` for a past one. Kalshi funding is the linear time-weighted mean of the per-second premium (second i of the window weighs i), set to 0 when its absolute value is below `funding_deadband` and clamped to `funding_cap`. `accrued_rate` is the weighted mean so far and equals Kalshi's own estimate; `weight_accrued` says how much of the final weight it represents (about 1.6% after the first hour of an 8-hour window). `projected_rate` fills the rest of the window with `assume_premium` (default: the mean of the last `recent_minutes`). For a past window `settled_rate` shows the published settlement next to the reconstruction. Rates are per interval; positive = longs pay.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
## kalshi_funding_nowcast(symbol, funding_time := NULL, assume_premium := NULL, recent_minutes := 15)

Kalshi funding is `sum(i * p_i) / sum(i)` over the seconds `i` of the window, zeroed inside the deadband and capped. This returns the accrued value, a projection to settlement, and for a past window the settled rate.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Where the next BTC funding settlement is heading", "sql": "SELECT weight_accrued, accrued_rate * 1e4 AS accrued_bps, projected_rate_annualized FROM perps.main.kalshi_funding_nowcast('KXBTCPERP')"}, {"description": "Settlement if the BTC premium holds at 2 bps for the rest of the window", "sql": "SELECT projected_rate_annualized FROM perps.main.kalshi_funding_nowcast('KXBTCPERP', assume_premium := 0.0002)"}, {"description": "The next Kalshi BTC settlement's projected annualized rate against the past week's settled average", "sql": "SELECT n.funding_time, n.weight_accrued, n.projected_rate_annualized, h.week_mean_apr, n.projected_rate_annualized - h.week_mean_apr AS vs_week FROM perps.main.kalshi_funding_nowcast('KXBTCPERP') AS n CROSS JOIN (SELECT avg(rate_annualized) AS week_mean_apr FROM perps.main.funding(venue := 'kalshi', underlying := 'BTC')) AS h"}]

Equals Kalshi's own estimate before rounding."}, {"name": "assumed_premium", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "Premium assumed for the rest of the window (assume_premium, else the mean of the last recent_minutes)."}, {"name": "projected_rate_raw", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "Projected window average before the deadband and cap."}, {"name": "projected_rate", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "Projected settlement per interval: 0 inside the deadband, clamped to the cap. Capability matrix: which data each venue serves publicly, with auth, depth and caveats

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Static capability matrix, one row per (venue, capability). Capabilities: instruments, funding_history, funding_estimate, marks, premium_index, open_interest, order_book, trades, candles, maintenance_margin. `support` is 'supported', 'partial' or 'unsupported' via public endpoints; `auth_required`, `history_depth` and `notes` say why. Use it to know in advance why, say, Coinbase funding history has only the latest rate or why Bitnomial has no order book. `venue := 'kalshi'` narrows to one venue. No network calls.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
## capabilities(venue := NULL)

What each venue serves publicly, whether it needs credentials, how far history goes, and the caveats.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "What Coinbase Derivatives does not serve publicly, and why", "sql": "SELECT capability, support, notes FROM perps.main.capabilities(venue := 'coinbase') WHERE support <> 'supported' ORDER BY capability"}, {"description": "How many venues fully support each capability", "sql": "SELECT capability, count(*) FILTER (WHERE support = 'supported') AS venues_supported FROM perps.main.capabilities() GROUP BY capability ORDER BY capability"}]

Kalshi and Bitnomial funding estimates are fetched only when `underlying` narrows the set (one request per contract). Offshore venues need `underlying`. Values change every call.

Cross-venue funding carry for one underlying: mean annualized rates per contract and the spread for every venue pair

rows.vgi.doc_llm: For one underlying (positional: `funding_spread('BTC')`), averages each contract's settled, annualized funding over the window (`start_date`/`end_date`, default last 7 days) and returns every pair of contracts on different venues: `annualized_a`, `annualized_b`, `spread_annualized` = a - b, `spread_bps`, observation counts and `carry_trade` ('short a / long b' collects a positive spread, because positive funding means longs pay). Includes the offshore benchmark venues. Before fees, basis moves and margin cost. Venues that fail are skipped with a warning.

## funding_spread(underlying, start_date := NULL, end_date := NULL)

Mean annualized funding per contract and the carry spread for every cross-venue pair.

Funding-rate history across venues, positive = longs pay shorts, with per-interval and annualized rates

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Settled funding rates, one row per contract per funding time. `rate_per_interval` is a decimal fraction (0.0001 = 1 bp) and positive always means longs pay shorts; `rate_annualized` = rate * 8760 / `interval_hours` (simple, not compounded); `rate_bps`; `mark_price`/`index_price`/`premium_bps` where the venue publishes them; `is_final`. Arguments: `venue := 'kalshi'`, `underlying := 'BTC'`, `start_date`/`end_date` (`TIMESTAMPTZ`, default the last 7 days), `include_estimates := true` to add each venue's in-progress estimate as is_final = false. Coinbase publishes only its latest hourly rate publicly. Offshore venues are included only when `underlying` is given.

## funding(venue := NULL, underlying := NULL, start_date := NULL, end_date := NULL, include_estimates := false)

Funding history in one sign convention (positive = longs pay shorts) with simple annualization.

Liquidity summary for one contract: spread, bps cost to fill a USD notional on each side, depth and imbalance

rows.vgi.doc_llm: One row summarizing a contract's book: `depth_metrics('kalshi', 'KXBTCPERP', notional_usd := 250000)`. Venue and symbol are positional. `spread_bps`; `buy_cost_bps` / `sell_cost_bps` = distance of the fill VWAP from mid when walking the asks / bids for `notional_usd` (default 100,000); `buy_filled_usd` / `sell_filled_usd` and `fully_filled` say whether the fetched `depth` (default 200 levels) was enough; `bid_depth_usd`, `ask_depth_usd`, `imbalance` in [-1, 1]. Excludes fees.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
## depth_metrics(venue, symbol, notional_usd := 100000, depth := 200)

rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name": "venue", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Venue name."}, {"name": "symbol", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Venue-native contract symbol."}, {"name": "best_bid", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "Best bid per underlying unit."}, {"name": "best_ask", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "Best ask per underlying unit."}, {"name": "mid", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "(best_bid + best_ask) / 2."}, {"name": "spread_bps", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "(best_ask - best_bid) / mid in basis points."}, {"name": "notional_usd", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "The notional each side was asked to fill."}, {"name": "buy_cost_bps", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "Distance of the VWAP to buy notional_usd (walking asks) from mid, bps."}, {"name": "sell_cost_bps", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "Distance of the VWAP to sell notional_usd (walking bids) from mid, bps."}, {"name": "buy_filled_usd", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "Notional the fetched asks could absorb (< notional_usd if the book ran out)."}, {"name": "sell_filled_usd", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "Notional the fetched bids could absorb."}, {"name": "fully_filled", "type": "BOOLEAN", "description": "True when both sides could fill the whole notional."}, {"name": "bid_depth_usd", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "Total bid notional in the fetched levels."}, {"name": "ask_depth_usd", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "Total ask notional in the fetched levels."}, {"name": "imbalance", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "(bid_depth_usd - ask_depth_usd) / (bid + ask): +1 all bids, -1 all asks."}, {"name": "bid_levels", "type": "INTEGER", "description": "Bid levels fetched."}, {"name": "ask_levels", "type": "INTEGER", "description": "Ask levels fetched."}]

List every venue with its regulatory type, supported capabilities and live health

rows.vgi.doc_llm: One row per venue: `venue` (the name every other function accepts), `venue_type` ('us_regulated' or 'offshore'), `regulator`, `adapter_version`, `sign_convention`, `capabilities` (list of capability names with full or partial support), and a live health probe: `status` ('ok', 'error', 'not_probed'), `instrument_count`, `last_error`, `checked_at`. Run it first: a venue with status 'error' (for example an offshore venue geo-blocked from the worker's network) is skipped by cross-venue queries. `probe := false` skips the network.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
## venues(probe := true)

Every venue, its regulatory type and capabilities, and a live health check. Cross-venue functions skip venues whose probe fails.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Which venues are reachable right now", "sql": "SELECT venue, status, instrument_count, last_error FROM perps.main.venues() ORDER BY venue"}, {"description": "US-regulated venues and how many capabilities each supports, without network calls", "sql": "SELECT venue, venue_type, len(capabilities) AS n_capabilities FROM perps.main.venues(probe := false) WHERE venue_type = 'us_regulated' ORDER BY venue"}, {"description": "Venues that answer right now and serve a public order book, with the endpoint each uses", "sql": "SELECT v.venue, v.status, c.notes FROM perps.main.venues() AS v JOIN perps.main.capabilities() AS c USING (venue) WHERE c.capability = 'order_book' AND c.support = 'supported' AND v.status = 'ok' ORDER BY v.venue"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name": "venue", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Venue name used by every other function's venue argument."}, {"name": "display_name", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Human-readable venue and product name."}, {"name": "venue_type", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "'us_regulated' (CFTC-registered exchange) or 'offshore' (benchmark only)."}, {"name": "regulator", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Regulatory status as documented by the venue."}, {"name": "adapter_version", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Version of this worker's adapter for the venue."}, {"name": "sign_convention", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "How the venue's funding sign maps to positive = longs pay shorts."}, {"name": "capabilities", "type": "VARCHAR[]", "description": "Capabilities with full or partial public support."}, {"name": "status", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "'ok' if the probe succeeded, 'error' if it failed, 'not_probed' when probe := false."}, {"name": "instrument_count", "type": "BIGINT", "description": "Active and inactive contracts the probe found; NULL unless status = 'ok'."}, {"name": "last_error", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Error from the probe, NULL when it succeeded."}, {"name": "checked_at", "type": "TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE", "description": "When the probe ran (UTC)."}]
